decisions: One compiled C# policy table supplies six library names, DLL names, optional declaration markers and exact export lists to both implementations through selfhost-sync.
Generate kernel32 and shell32 first, then optional ole32/ws2_32/bcrypt after separate bounded prefix scans, then ucrtbase. Propagate read errors instead of interpreting them as an absent marker.
Render UTF-8 without BOM using LF separators and no final newline. Use llvm-lib /nologo /machine:x64 /def:path /out:path in declaration order.
SLG owns generated library paths; do not retain Text borrowed from an arena that is subsequently mutated. Caller owns work-directory allocation and lifecycle.
This import-generation unit does not establish effective CPU count, partition concurrency, full driver linking or Stage2/Stage3 equivalence. Keep the original Windows linker paired denominator 16.
